# Pinned eval set for issue #205 — agent-team-review lead adjudication.
# NEVER DELETE. Each non-comment, non-blank line is a LITERAL needle (grep -F)
# that MUST appear in skills/agent-team-review/SKILL.md.
#
# THIS FILE IS NOT THE SOLE AUTHORITY. tests/test-review-adjudication.sh
# independently hardcodes the issue-#205 anchors and asserts they are present
# HERE, and pins a count floor equal to the needle count — so deleting a needle
# fails the gate instead of silently deleting its own assertion. That leak was
# measured on the sibling dispatch-brief gate; do not reintroduce it by making
# this file the only source of needles.
#
# A needle must stay on ONE physical line in SKILL.md. Reflowing a paragraph
# breaks the literal match and fails the gate — the safe direction (false FAIL,
# never false PASS), but reflow deliberately.
#
# Provenance: issue #205, from memory/reviewer-findings-need-isolated-reproduction.md
# (observed 2026-08-12: a real finding against hooks/lib/git-command.sh was nearly
# dismissed because the reproduction harness had several faults active at once).
# The measured pairings behind it live in seeded-findings.md, in this directory.

# --- Clause 1: the rule itself — one variable, and the pair must disagree ---
Change exactly one thing, and build a pair that COULD disagree
you have not tested the claim

# --- Clause 2: the masking mechanism, named so it can be recognised ---
an upstream fail-closed gate masks a downstream fall-open one

# --- Clause 3: BOTH directions — rejecting and accepting are equally gated ---
Before rejecting
Before accepting

# --- Clause 4: a failed reproduction is not a refutation ---
you have not refuted the finding, you have only failed to trigger it

# --- Clause 5: escalation when the pair cannot be obtained ---
could-not-reproduce
Keep the finding at the severity it carries

# --- Clause 6: isolation — reproduction never touches the shared tree ---
git worktree add --detach
Never write to the shared working tree while adjudicating

# --- Clause 7: the pairing is recorded, so an unexamined verdict is visible ---
Record the pairing, not just the verdict

# --- Clause 8: scope — structural security/governance findings are EXEMPT ---
# Without this, §4a silently repeals the finding contract's structural exception
# and demands a runnable pair for "this removes a safety constraint".
experimentally decidable causal claim
findings blocking on the structural criterion the finding contract already allows

# --- Clause 9: the oracle is named BEFORE the run, and is not always allow/deny ---
The oracle is whatever the finding predicts

# --- Clause 10: a non-flipping pair has three explanations, only one is "false" ---
A pair that does not flip is not, on its own, proof of falsity

# --- Clause 11: the worktree must carry the REVIEWED change, not its parent ---
adjudicates the PARENT state

# --- Clause 12: a non-flip decides "false" only against a POSITIVE control ---
# Without this the procedure contradicts its own seeded FALSE cells, which
# reject on a no-flip.
a non-flip decides "false" only once the other two are ruled out
positive control that proves the harness could have detected it

# --- Clause 13: an open finding constrains the verdict, it is not "clean" ---
An OPEN finding is not a clean one
the verdict MUST NOT be `clean`

# --- Clause 14: the uncommitted delta is taken against HEAD, not the base ---
# `git diff {base_sha}` re-applies committed changes already in the sha.
Diff against HEAD, NOT against

# --- Clause 15: the finding contract carries the oracle, so the lead does not
# invent it after seeing the result ---
Oracle: what observably differs when the claim holds

# --- Clause 16: the positive control must be COMPARABLE, not merely known-good ---
The control must be COMPARABLE, not merely known-good

# --- Clause 17: the summary's pairing requirement carries the same structural
# exemption as §4a, or it demands a pair that cannot exist ---
adjudicated BY PAIRING carries its §4a pairing inline

# --- Clause 18: untracked files must be COPIED, not merely listed ---
discovering them is not carrying them
